title: Checkpoint Reload Explains Most of the Measured State Gap in Two State Discovery Reproductions
abstract: arXiv:2610.34891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal models that maintain per-sequence latent states during training must reconstruct those states when the stored table is unavailable at inference. This creates a basic consistency question: do the reconstructed states agree with those formed during training? We study this question for State Discovery in World Machine, which updates stored states in parallel each epoch but performs inference by sequential rollout from an all-zero start. On Toy1D, we analyze two paired-checkpoint runs whose decoded-state MSE is 27 to 36 percent above the published value. We compare the stored table with rollouts under the best-validation checkpoint reloaded after training and the last-epoch weights that wrote the table. Matching the rollout to the table-writing weights removes 90 to 91 percent of the mean per-dimension Wasserstein-1 distance. Causal distillation and frozen SD updates do not satisfy their pre-specified criteria under either checkpoin

translated_title: 检查点重载解释了两次状态发现复现中所测得状态差距的大部分
translated_abstract: 在训练期间维护每个序列潜在状态的时间模型，在推理时若存储的状态表不可用，就必须重建这些状态。这引出一个基本的一致性问题：重建的状态是否与训练期间形成的状态一致？我们针对World Machine中的状态发现（State Discovery）研究这一问题，该方法在每个epoch并行更新存储的状态，但推理时却从全零起点通过顺序展开（rollout）进行。在Toy1D上，我们分析了两次配对检查点运行，其解码状态的MSE比已发表值高出27%至36%。我们将存储的状态表与两种设置下的展开结果进行比较：一是训练后重载的最佳验证集检查点，二是写入该状态表的最后epoch权重。将展开结果与写入表的权重匹配后，平均每维Wasserstein-1距离减少了90%至91%。而因果蒸馏和冻结SD更新在任一检查点下均未满足其预设标准。
tldr: 论文发现，两次状态发现复现中测得的状态差距主要由检查点重载导致——将推理展开与写入状态表的最后epoch权重匹配，可消除90%至91%的平均每维Wasserstein-1距离。
en_tdlr: Checkpoint reload explains most of the measured state gap in State Discovery reproductions—matching inference rollouts to the last-epoch table-writing weights removes 90-91% of the mean per-dimension Wasserstein-1 distance.
